question: Who among the following founded Brahmo Samaj in Calcutta (Kolkata)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raja Ram Mohan Roy.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brahmo Samaj **is the societal thing of Brahmoism, which commenced as a monotheistic reformist motion of the Hindu religion that was regarded for the duration of the Bengal Renaissance.
 
• It becomes started in Calcutta on** 20 August 1828 **by Raja Ram Mohan Roy and Dwarkanath Tagore.
 
• **Divisions of Brahmo Samaj**
 
 
• Adi Brahmo Samaj
 
• Sadharan Brahmo Samaj
 
 
 
• **In 1861** the Brahmo Samaj become founded in Lahore via Nobin Roy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swami Vivekananda, **become an Indian Hindu monk, truth seeker, writer, religious teacher, and the leading disciple of the Indian mystic Ramakrishna.
 
• **Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar** changed into an Indian educator and social reformer of the** 19th century.**
 
• **Dayanand Saraswati **became an Indian logician, social chief, and founding father of the Arya Samaj, a reform movement of the Vedic dharma.
